title: Interpretable Machine Learning Accelerated Discovery of Doped Spinel Co3O4 Catalysts for the Oxygen Evolution Reaction
summary: Models screened 252 sites; experiments tested Al- and Fe-doped Co3O4 and reported oxygen-evolution activity under near-neutral conditions. Other dopants remain computational predictions.
